default_in_repayment.text:
a)In our opinion, the Company has not defaulted in the repayment of loans to bank. There are no borrowings from financial institutions and government, and the Company has not issued any debentures.

b)The Company has not been declared wilful defaulter by any bank or financial institution or government or any government authority

fraud.text:
a) To the best of our knowledge, no fraud by the Company and no material fraud on the Company has been noticed or reported during the year ended March 31, 2026.

b) To the best of our knowledge, no report under sub-section (12) of Section 143 of the Companies Act has been filed in Form ADT-4 as prescribed under rule 13 of Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 with the Central Government, during the year and upto the date of this report.

c) We have taken into consideration the whistle blower complaints received by the Company during the year and provided to us, when performing our audit.

statutory_dues.text:

operating_notes.text: USFDA issued an EIR with VAI status, concluding the unannounced inspection conducted Feb 2-6, 2026 at the Puducherry Ibuprofen facility as closed.
Accumulated losses stood at ₹319.33 Cr and net current liabilities exceeded net current assets by ₹35.81 Cr as of March 31, 2026.
Synthix Global Pharma Solutions Limited was incorporated on April 29, 2025 to explore demerger of CRAMS and Polymers business.
Bankers appointed to evaluate strategic options for the commodity Ibuprofen business.
Bankers appointed to evaluate strategic options for the commodity Ibuprofen business, expected to conclude in H1 FY27.
H1FY27 operating cash flow was ₹63.35 Cr against EBITDA of ₹138.81 Cr, with trade receivables up ₹66.83 Cr.
Accumulated losses stood at ₹274.16 Cr at Sep-2026 versus ₹319.33 Cr at Mar-2026, and the results are prepared on a going concern basis.
The Group operates in a single reportable segment, Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API).
Q2FY27 exceptional items of ₹4.50 Cr relate to loss on sale of unusable plant and equipment at the Vizag facility.
Final reminder notice issued for outstanding first and second/final call money on partly paid-up equity shares, payable between October 22 and November 5, 2026.
Ibuprofen business showed recovery with revenue growing 21% YoY to ₹91 Cr and nearly reaching breakeven at EBITDA level.

timeline.summary: Solara received USFDA EIR classifying its Puducherry Ibuprofen facility as VAI and closed the inspection conducted in February 2026.
Pronomz Ventures LLP, acting through **Chandrappa Seetharamaiah**, declared no new encumbrances on Solara Active Pharma Sciences shares on **April 6, 2026**, beyond prior disclosures.

Solara Active Pharma Sciences Limited schedules an Investors/Analysts Conference Call on May 15, 2026, at 15:00 IST to discuss Q4FY26 audited financial results, featuring Arun Kumar, Sandeep Rao, and Sarat Kumar.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹387.29 Cr (+41.9% YoY), net profit ₹9.6 Cr (against a loss of ₹2.1 Cr a year earlier).
Solara Active Pharma reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹391.90 crore and net profit of ₹9.60 crore, and appointed bankers for its Ibuprofen business.
Solara Active Pharma approved the conversion of 1.15 Cr partly paid-up shares to fully paid-up equity upon receiving ₹129.94 Cr in second and final call monies.
Crisil Ratings issued the Monitoring Agency Report for Solara Active Pharma Sciences' rights issue for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Solara Active Pharma Sciences hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 15, 2026, highlighting base business momentum and strategic evaluations for the ibuprofen segment.
Pronomz Ventures LLP, acting for Solara Active Pharma Sciences Limited’s promoters, declared no new encumbrances on shares on **06 April 2026** under SEBI’s takeover regulations.

Solara Active Pharma Sciences Limited schedules an analysts/investors conference call on October 16, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST to discuss unaudited Q2FY27 and H1FY27 results, with Sandeep Rao (MD & CEO) and Sarat Kumar (CFO) presenting.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹417.34 Cr (+33.1% YoY), net profit ₹28.46 Cr (against a loss of ₹10.1 Cr a year earlier).
Solara Active Pharma Sciences reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹417.34 Cr and PAT of ₹28.50 Cr.
On 17 October 2026, Solara Active Pharma issued a final reminder notice for outstanding call money on partly paid-up shares.
Solara Active Pharma reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹418 Cr and PAT of ₹28.5 Cr during an earnings call.
